checks.exercise: Canonical pronated pull-up; front/side sequences and both 32-frame final sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Fixed horizontal bar and two upright supports remain stationary and in frame.
checks.setup: Suspended body below bar, overhand hands wider than shoulders; no mounting/dismounting shown.
checks.hands: Both grip sockets stay on the bar; closed fingers and thumb wrap. Maximum sampled grip error below 7e-15 model units.
checks.feet: Feet remain suspended and translate with the trunk without a kicking cycle.
checks.movement: Chin clears bar at peak; elbows return to about 171 degrees. Continuous eight-second cycle, no camera or pose jump.

checks.exercise: Seated overhand lat pulldown; front/side sequences and both 32-frame final sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Seat, thigh restraint, rear stack and overhead cable visible. Bar and stack travel opposite equal distances; cable routing is simplified.
checks.setup: Slight fixed torso recline, seated hips and thighs under restraint; stable camera.
checks.hands: Closed overhand grip follows both ends of the bar; maximum sampled socket error below 6e-15.
checks.feet: Both feet stay stationary on the calibrated support platform.
checks.movement: Bar descends in front toward upper chest, then returns overhead; elbows about 61–168 degrees. No torso swing.

checks.exercise: Bilateral 45-degree leg press; front/side sequences and both 32-frame final sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Footplate, sled sleeves, side plates, rails, seat, backrest and handles visible; rail motion remains at 45 degrees.
checks.setup: Reclined torso and hips fixed against the support; safety-release and entry/exit omitted.
checks.hands: Both hands keep a closed grip at the side handles with no drift.
checks.feet: Both feet remain on the plate at shoulder-width stance; plate position follows rendered soles.
checks.movement: Knees flex from 165 to 95 degrees and extend without locking; torso remains fixed. Full loop and both themes inspected.
